name: music-mod
description: /music: what macOS Music.app is playing, in a pane beside the transcript. Track, artist, album, a progress bar, Music and system volume, the playlist position and the track up next, refreshed every two seconds while the pane is open, with previous, play/pause and next controls.

refreshMs.title: Refresh interval
refreshMs.description: Milliseconds between reads of Music.app while the pane is open. 2000 by default; 500 at the least.
